title: Kindness
lyrics: It's Your [C]kindness, [G]Lord, that [Am7]leads us to repentance.
It's Your [C]beauty, [G]Lord, that [Am7]makes us stand in silence
And [C]Your love, Your love is better than [G]life.
We can feeel Your mercy falling.
You are turning our hearts back again.
Hear our praises rise to heaven.
Draw us near, Lord, meet us here.
artist: Chris Tomlin, Jesse Reeves, Louie Giglio

sourceMetadata.presentation: V1 C V2 C C V1
